name: New-grad engineer intake, 2028 joiners (Term 1)

language_note: Japanese 'Not required' (business English) for: Cloud Platform Software Engineer, AI & Data Data Engineer, Cloud Platform Data Engineer, AI Engineer, Research Scientist. deadline_note: Same Term 1 window as the engineer intake
language_note: Japanese 'Not required to Business Level', English 'Not required to Business Level'. The only Rakuten product role that does not insist on Japanese; every other Rakuten PM role needs business or native Japanese.

pay: From JPY 370,000 a month, including fixed overtime

name: Class of 2028 Software Engineer Internship (the route to a new-grad offer)

fit_note: Open to anyone who can join as a new graduate in October 2027 or April 2028, which matches a mid-2027 IIT graduation. Needs backend, frontend, mobile or platform development experience.
how: 2 to 3 month internship in Japan, at least 20 hours a week. Mercari arranges the visa, flights and housing for overseas interns. Most new grads join after one of these internships.

name: 2027 Institutional Equity Division Full-Time Analyst Program (Tokyo)
deadline_note: 30 Nov 2026, 23:55 JST; reviewed on a rolling basis, so offers can go before the deadline
language_note: 'Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English are required; Japanese proficiency is not required.'
fit_note: Graduated or graduating by July 2027 with a bachelor's or higher in mathematics, physics, computer science or another quantitative discipline. Needs one programming language with solid software-engineering basics. The work is pricing, risk analytics and tools with trading, sales and structuring. Visa sponsorship and relocation for graduates of universities outside Japan.
how: Apply through Morgan Stanley careers (the posting is on LinkedIn). Questions: Recruit.Japan@morganstanley.com.

language_note: The posting does not mention Japanese. Ask Recruit.Japan@morganstanley.com before investing in it.

how: Apply through Morgan Stanley careers (the posting is on LinkedIn).

language_note: The posting does not mention Japanese.

name: Global South-Japan Tech Talent Internship (GS-JTI) 2026
deadline_note: Rolling; every course closes by end of November 2026; coding tests run in batches until then
language_note: English working proficiency required; Japanese not required.
fit_note: Current students or graduates within 3 years, STEM (IT, AI, semiconductors), from OECD DAC countries including India. The online option (2 weeks to 1 month) fits the IIT winter break. Does not guarantee a job, but puts you in front of Japanese employers.
pay: In person: airfare, housing, insurance and JPY 2,000 a day
how: Register on Talendy, take the coding test or register skills, apply to posted internships, interview with the company.

name: Global Internship Program (GIP)
deadline_note: First come, first served in each batch
language_note: 'Fluent in English; Japanese not required.'
fit_note: Third-year undergraduates and above, and recent graduates. Needs real coding (Python, Go, React or Vue with TypeScript) and a CS degree or equivalent experience.
joining: Full-stack 4 to 6 weeks, or front-end 5 weeks, in Shibuya
pay: Unpaid, with housing allowance, round-trip airfare, medical insurance and a phone
how: Register, pass the coding challenge with CV and cover letter, HR interview, then technical interview. Strong interns are offered full-time jobs.

name: Sony Japan careers board (global hiring)
deadline_note: Per role; roles close when filled
language_note: Sony's global recruiting: interviews in English and '95% of roles do NOT have Japanese language skill requirements'.
fit_note: Twelve roles open on 7 Oct 2026, mostly AI research full-time and internship roles in Tokyo; several prefer a master's or PhD. The bigger global-hiring round has opened around December with a February deadline in past years.
how: Apply per role on Workday. Sony pays visa, flights and relocation for full-time hires and interns. fetch_japan.py pulls this board.
